summary: P0 bug fix verification: After login (user@winek.app / WinekUser2024!), all 4 tabs work correctly. Profile (Menu) tab shows 'Thomas Dupont', NOT 'Veuillez vous connecter'. Bookings (Notifications) tab shows 'Mes réservations', NOT 'Connectez-vous pour voir vos réservations'. Map (Accueil) shows tagpoints correctly. Backend /auth/me returns user with valid token. Fixed 1 backend bug (TagPoint creation 500 error). All 26 backend tests pass.

minor.issue: 500 error due to missing table alias 'tp' and LEFT JOIN in post-insert SELECT query. Fixed: queries at lines 260, 277, 295 now use 'FROM tag_points tp LEFT JOIN users u ON tp.user_id = u.user_id WHERE tp.point_id = $1'

issues: Map tile area shows dark/empty on initial load - normal for Leaflet/web rendering, not a regression

action_items: None critical. TagPoint creation 500 bug has been fixed in tagpoint_routes.py (3 queries).
Minor: 'my tag points' section in profile shows test data (TEST_Point...) from automated tests. Not a bug, but test cleanup could be added.
critical_code_review_comments: tagpoint_routes.py: TP_FIELDS uses 'tp.' aliased fields, but 3 SELECT queries (create, update) were missing 'tp' alias and 'LEFT JOIN users' clause - caused 500 on create/update. Fixed in this iteration.
test_winek_api.py: test_update_profile_name was restoring name to 'Test User' instead of 'Thomas Dupont' (seed data name). Fixed restore value.

AuthContext.tsx fix is correct: loadingguard in profile.tsx/bookings.tsx (if loading → ActivityIndicator; if !loading && !user → fallback refreshUser) properly handles the race condition between auth init and tab render.
refreshUser in AuthContext reads token from localStorage via api.ts (storage.get('winek_token')), so the fallback works correctly when token is persisted.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all P0 scenarios pass - profile shows user, bookings shows content)

seed_data_creation: TEST_ prefixed tagpoints created during backend tests. User name restored to 'Thomas Dupont' after test changed it to 'Test User'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: P0 bug is FULLY FIXED and verified. Login → map works. Profile tab (Menu) shows Thomas Dupont after login. Bookings tab shows 'Mes réservations' (empty but no error). /auth/me API works. All 26 backend tests pass. Fix applied: (1) AuthContext.tsx - OAuth early return keeps loading=true; processGoogleCallback manages setLoading; refreshUser in useCallback. (2) profile.tsx + bookings.tsx - loading guard (ActivityIndicator) before !user check + useEffect fallback refreshUser() when !loading && !user. Also fixed tagpoint_routes.py 500 bug (missing tp alias in 3 queries). Minor issue from iteration 2 still open: hardcoded address string in search.tsx line 226.
rca_of_issue: P0 Root Cause: AuthContext.tsx was calling setLoading(false) even in the OAuth early-return case (line 68 before fix), causing loading to flip to false before processGoogleCallback resolved the user. When tabs mounted immediately after login, loading=false and user=null → guard showed 'Veuillez vous connecter'. Fix: skip setLoading(false) in the OAuth early return (keep loading=true until processGoogleCallback finishes), add loading spinner guard in profile/bookings before the !user check, and add fallback refreshUser() when !loading && !user to recover from any edge case where checkAuth completed before tab mount but user was missed.
